 Job Description:
 
 The Role   

 As a Software Engineer, you will design, build, test, deploy, and support secure, enterprise-grade Python applications, APIs, automation, and reusable software components. You will apply modern engineering practices across testing, CI/CD, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, observability, and production support to deliver scalable and reliable solutions. You will collaborate with engineers, architects, platform teams, and business partners to translate requirements into maintainable software. You will also use AI-assisted development tools to improve software quality, delivery speed, documentation, and troubleshooting.   

 The Expertise and Skills You Bring   
 2–4 years of software engineering experience, with strong Python development skills across applications, APIs, services, automation, or reusable components.   
 Experience delivering secure, scalable, maintainable, and well-tested enterprise-grade software using object-oriented programming, modular architecture, design principles, data structures, type hints, packaging, dependency management, exception handling, and clean-code practices.   
 Experience designing and integrating REST APIs, including request validation, authentication and authorization, error handling, API versioning, and backward compatibility.   
 Experience building production-ready services, including configuration management, failure recovery, performance optimization, resiliency, and supportability.   
 Experience with automated testing, including unit, integration, regression, mocks, fixtures, code coverage, and performance testing.   
 Experience diagnosing application defects, runtime failures, and performance bottlenecks and implementing sustainable solutions through root-cause analysis. Participation in an on-call rotation is expected to resolve engineering incidents escalated beyond Level 1 support.   
 Experience with GitHub or Jenkins-based CI/CD workflows, including source control, testing, packaging, artifact management, deployment, and release automation; Artifactory exposure is beneficial.   
 Experience deploying and troubleshooting containerized applications on Kubernetes in AWS or Azure; Infrastructure as Code experience with Terraform, AWS CloudFormation, or Azure Resource Manager is beneficial.   
 Understanding of secure software development, including code review, dependency and vulnerability remediation, secrets protection, and secure cloud configuration.   
 Working knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and production observability, including structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, dashboards, monitoring, and actionable alerting.   
 Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and collaboration skills, with a demonstrated ability to learn new technologies and improve quality, reliability, and operational excellence.   
 Familiarity with ETL/ELT, Apache Airflow, Apache Spark, or distributed data processing is beneficial but not required; AWS or Azure certification is preferred.   
 
 The Team   
 Our team develops and supports Python software, automation, and cloud-native platform capabilities that help engineering teams deliver secure, reliable, and scalable applications. We partner with software engineers, architects, platform and support teams, and business stakeholders to solve technical challenges and establish reusable engineering patterns. We improve developer productivity, software quality, operational reliability, and time to market through automation and modern engineering practices. Team members can deepen their Python expertise while gaining experience with cloud technologies, Kubernetes, observability, platform engineering, and AI-assisted software development. 
 Fidelity’s Onsite Working Model 
Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Currently, some roles and locations require 100% onsite presence, while others require less. Onsite expectations are likely to evolve as the rollout continues. This transition does not apply to fully remote roles.
